reasons.glass_damage_covered: A cracked windshield from a stone is glass damage and the policy is stated to cover glass damage, so P(true) is very high.
reasons.handling_mode: The user-instruction objective is 'scoring', which as semantic configuration selects the scoring output over routing or payment gating.
reasons.claim_complexity: A documented windshield claim with photo and quote plus a fixed excess is mostly straightforward, with residual checking of the quote and policy validity.
